statements.status_notes: Fixed in DHI expat 2.8.3-r1 by backporting upstream libexpat PR #1326 (merge commit 5935b102a528a85401ff982263b176c28df26618), which correctly treats getentropy() returning zero as success and preserves strong entropy for hash-flooding protection.

Fixed in DHI expat 2.8.3-r1 by backporting upstream libexpat PR #1321 (merge commit e97a6c453a4ef0595953e3f72f64ad1b74afc96a), which migrates storeAtts() isCdata lookup from a linear scan to a hash table and removes the quadratic CPU complexity.
